canonical_formula: If {i,j}=P(r,x)={x,x+r mod n} with shortest circular separation r and the upper endpoint chosen for diametric pairs, then t(P(r,x))=(r-1)n+n-x.
consequences: The unique pair of each weight 1,...,binom(n,2) is determined by the formula.
The unique hardest pair is {0,floor(n/2)} in this labeling.
